newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat yields, quality better than expected.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat yields, quality better than expected.

text.p: Better than anticipated is how what yields and quality have been widely reported as the British harvest progresses, according to the Home Grown Cereals Authority.
"Average yields and quality are expected to be down on last year's high results, but plantings were larger," the HGCA said in its Weekly Bulletin.
On the basis of early cuts of wheat, the total harvest looked unlikely to be below 15 million tonnes, the HGCA said, compared with the 16.1 million achieved last year.
"So far hagbergs and protein seem adequate, helping to reduce breadwheat prices by three stg last week." Hagberg is a measure of wheat quality.
"Specific weights seem to be down on last year, but are generally satisfactory," the HGCA said.
Recent cuts appeared to confirm earlier impressions of lower barley yields and quality, the HGCA said.
